prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1494; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Records show long-standing treatment for the same condition before the crash; most of the current complaints come from it.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: The patient presented after a parking lot collision with a reported fracture of the wrist. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported fracture. Over eight visits, care followed a typical course and was tapered as the patient improved. Some examination findings support the presence of a wrist injury, while other tests were within normal limits. Review of the records shows long-standing treatment for the same region before the collision, and much of the current symptom burden appears to relate to that earlier condition rather than to the recent event. Two similar charges recorded on the same day are under review for accuracy. Ongoing follow-up will focus on functional recovery of the wrist, and the relative contribution of the prior condition will be considered when assessing remaining limitations.
